title: 卡里巴水壩~Kariba Dam
focus: 由卡里巴修復工程連結拱壩水墊沖蝕與閘門界面~Connecting Kariba rehabilitation with arch action plunge-pool scour and gate interfaces
summary: 本課以由卡里巴修復工程連結拱壩水墊沖蝕與閘門界面為主線，先用拱作用與壩肩傳力與水位荷載與非線性界定水力與構造條件，再將節理壓差與拔出、圍堰抽排與水量連結到修復效益與同工況。本課模型只是修復議題的機制示意，未重建卡里巴設計；舊工程頁的預定完工年不當實際完工事實。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops connecting Kariba rehabilitation with arch action plunge-pool scour and gate interfaces through Arch action and abutment transfer and Reservoir load and nonlinear response, then connects Joint pressure and block removal and Cofferdam dewatering balance to Rehabilitation benefit and matched states. Models illustrate rehabilitation mechanisms without reconstructing Kariba design; old scheduled completion dates are not treated as achieved milestones. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 卡里巴壩橫跨尚比西河，管理局2015年公告記載原壩於1956至1959年間建造。業主說明自1958年蓄水起持續監測，後續修復議題包括水墊沖蝕與溢洪閘門運轉。這些資料讓本課把長期監測、岩體沖坑及閘槽變形連成完整的維護問題，而不將修復簡化成一次混凝土補強。官方舊頁仍含預定工期，本課不據此宣稱目前完工狀態。教學載重、沖坑尺寸與設備能力全部另行假設，不是卡里巴的設計或監測數值。~Kariba crosses the Zambezi. The authority records construction during1956–1959 and monitoring since1958 impoundment. Subsequent rehabilitation addresses plunge-pool erosion and spillway-gate operation, linking rock scour, gate-clearance change and long-term observation. Old owner pages retain forecast schedules, which are not used to claim present completion. All lesson loads, scour dimensions and equipment capacities are independently assumed and are not Kariba design values or monitoring records.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查拱作用與壩肩傳力：Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa；再獨立檢查水位荷載與非線性：Unit projected width=1 m; waterDepth=80 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*80**2=31392 kN per m width。敏感度：相同射流合力900kN分布於30或45m2時，平均壓力由30降至20kPa；擴大作用面積可降低平均值，但岩節理瞬時壓力及局部峰值仍須獨立驗證。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。本課模型只是修復議題的機制示意，未重建卡里巴設計；舊工程頁的預定完工年不當實際完工事實。 將沿槽全高量測淨距並與啟閉負荷及溫度時序比較作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Arch action and abutment transfer: Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa. Independently examine Reservoir load and nonlinear response: Unit projected width=1 m; waterDepth=80 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*80**2=31392 kN per m width. Sensitivity: spreading the same900kN resultant over30 rather than45m2 changes mean pressure from30 to20kPa. A larger area lowers the mean, while joint-pressure pulses and local peaks still require independent verification. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Models illustrate rehabilitation mechanisms without reconstructing Kariba design; old scheduled completion dates are not treated as achieved milestones. Use the following independent check: Survey clearance throughout the slot and compare operating loads and temperature histories. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 拱作用與壩肩傳力~Arch action and abutment transfer
units.title: 拱作用與壩肩傳力~Arch action and abutment transfer
units.mechanism: 卡里巴的拱壩背景要求理解水壓如何經曲率傳向壩肩，水平薄環近似只處理一部分受力。實際壩同時具有懸臂、接縫與地基相互作用，不能把一條薄拱環代表全壩；壩肩剛度與節理會改變拱向力分配。 驗證時應以壩體位移及壩肩地質模型核對拱向傳力假設，並辨識以下失效情境：壩肩柔化可能使原本假設的拱向分配失效。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Kariba provides context for pressure transfer through curvature toward abutments. A thin horizontal ring represents only one component of response. Real behavior includes cantilever action, joints and foundation interaction; one ring cannot stand for the whole dam, and abutment stiffness changes the load distribution. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare dam displacement and abutment geology with assumed arch load transfer. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Abutment softening can invalidate the assumed arch-force distribution. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Ideal thin ring: pressure=0.6 MPa; radius=100 m; thickness=15 m; hoopCompression=0.6*100/15=4 MPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Diagnose it by the following check: Compare dam displacement and abutment geology with assumed arch load transfer. units.anchor: 水位荷載與非線性~Reservoir load and nonlinear response
units.title: 水位荷載與非線性~Reservoir load and nonlinear response
units.mechanism: 水位變化同時改變受壓高度與壓力大小，合力因此不與水深線性成長。用矩形投影估水平靜水力可說明尺度，拱壩實際位移還受溫度及接縫開合影響；監測比較必須分離水位與季節效應。 驗證時應以不同季節相同水位的位移資料比較可逆反應，並辨識以下失效情境：把溫度變形全歸因水位會錯估荷載敏感度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Stage changes both loaded height and pressure, so resultant force does not grow linearly with depth. A projected rectangular surface illustrates horizontal loading, while actual arch displacement also depends on temperature and joint opening. Monitoring comparisons must separate stage and seasonal effects. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare displacement at the same stage in different seasons to identify reversible response. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Attributing all thermal movement to stage misstates load sensitivity. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 水舌入池能量~Jet energy entering the pool
units.title: 水舌入池能量~Jet energy entering the pool
units.mechanism: 溢流水舌攜帶動能進入水墊，能量率可用流量與落差估尺度，但實際分布受閘門組合與水舌含氣影響。總功率不能決定單一岩塊荷載，需把全系統能量和局部壓力分開量測，才能評估修復目標。 驗證時應同步記錄各孔流量水位與水舌落點並比較池底壓力，並辨識以下失效情境：總流量相同但閘門組合不同可能移動集中沖擊區。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Spill jets carry energy into the plunge pool, with discharge and head defining a system-level rate. Gate combinations and aeration alter its distribution. Total power does not determine force on one rock block; separate global energy accounting from local pressure measurements when evaluating rehabilitation objectives. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record gate flows, levels and jet footprints together with bed pressures. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Equal total flow with different gate combinations can shift concentrated impact. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=200 m3/s; netDrop=60 m; power=1000*9.81*200*60/1e6=117.72 MW。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=200 m3/s; netDrop=60 m; power=1000*9.81*200*60/1e6=117.72 MW. units.anchor: 水墊展寬與平均壓力~Pool spreading and mean pressure
units.title: 水墊展寬與平均壓力~Pool spreading and mean pressure
units.mechanism: 水墊整形希望改善射流擴散與下游出流，不能把增加體積直接解讀為所有壓力都按比例下降。平均合力除面積只是整體量級，局部脈壓與回流仍可能集中；需用多點同步壓力與流場驗證整形後的分布。 驗證時應比較整形前後同工況下的壓力分布及回流範圍，並辨識以下失效情境：只報平均壓力下降會掩蓋新形成的局部高壓點。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Pool reshaping aims to improve spreading and downstream conveyance. More volume does not make every pressure fall proportionally. Force divided by area describes an average, while pulses and recirculation may remain concentrated; validate distributions with synchronized pressure arrays and flow observations. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare pressure distributions and recirculation before and after reshaping at matched conditions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A reduced mean can conceal a newly concentrated high-pressure location. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 節理壓差與拔出~Joint pressure and block removal
units.title: 節理壓差與拔出~Joint pressure and block removal
units.mechanism: 岩床沖蝕常受節理塊體控制，脈壓可沿連通裂隙傳到塊底，與頂面壓力形成淨揚力。給定壓差乘面積僅計水力一項，抗力仍含水下重量、咬合與剪阻；完整岩石強度不能代替節理調查。 驗證時應同步量測節理內外壓力並核對岩塊形狀及連通裂隙，並辨識以下失效情境：連通節理可使低平均水面壓力下仍發生局部拔出。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Scour in jointed rock often involves blocks. Pressure pulses transmitted through connected cracks create uplift relative to the block top. Differential pressure times area gives one hydraulic component; submerged weight, interlock and shear provide separate resistance. Intact rock strength cannot replace joint mapping. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure pressures inside and outside joints and map block geometry and connectivity. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Connected joints can enable local plucking despite low mean surface pressure. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：underBlockPressure=90 kPa; topPressure=60 kPa; blockArea=2 m2; netUplift=(90-60)*2=60 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: underBlockPressure=90 kPa; topPressure=60 kPa; blockArea=2 m2; netUplift=(90-60)*2=60 kN. units.anchor: 回向沖蝕與距離~Backward scour and separation distance
units.title: 回向沖蝕與距離~Backward scour and separation distance
units.mechanism: 沖坑朝壩基方向擴展的後果與相對位置有關，不能只追蹤最大深度。平面最短距離可做監測指標，但安全判定還需三維岩體、可能滑移面與水力作用；量測基準和沖坑邊界定義應保持一致。 驗證時應以同基準三維地形比較沖坑邊緣深度與壩基相對位置，並辨識以下失效情境：只測最深點會漏掉較淺但朝壩基推進的侵蝕。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Scour moving toward the foundation matters through location as well as maximum depth. Plan separation is a monitoring indicator, not a safety verdict. Three-dimensional rock geometry, potential sliding surfaces and hydraulics still govern consequences; maintain consistent survey datums and edge definitions over time. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare scour edges and depths relative to the foundation using consistent three-dimensional surveys. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Tracking only the deepest point misses shallower erosion advancing toward the foundation. units.anchor: 圍堰抽排與水量~Cofferdam dewatering balance
units.title: 圍堰抽排與水量~Cofferdam dewatering balance
units.mechanism: 既有水工修復的圍堰抽排需要隔離施工區並維持核准水位，抽水能力要與滲入及降雨來源配對。定入流蓄水式只估短時水位變化，不能取代地基隆起、圍堰穩定及停電工況；應同步監測內外水頭與抽排量。 驗證時應記錄抽排量內外水位與地基孔壓並核對停泵反應，並辨識以下失效情境：抽排加快可能增大內外水頭差而改變地基風險。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Rehabilitation cofferdams isolate a work area under approved level conditions. Pumping must be matched to seepage and rainfall inputs. A short-interval balance estimates level change only; it does not address heave, cofferdam stability or power failure, which require concurrent head and flow monitoring. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record pumping, inside and outside levels and foundation pressures and examine pump-stop response. units.anchor: 閘槽變形與淨距~Sluice deformation and clearance
units.title: 閘槽變形與淨距~Sluice deformation and clearance
units.mechanism: 長期混凝土變形可能影響閘槽淨距與啟閉，需區分材料膨脹、溫度與結構位移。幾何扣減能示範餘隙消耗，但實際閘門摩擦和扭斜還受支承及止水影響；應沿全行程查核而非只量單一開度。 驗證時應沿槽全高量測淨距並與啟閉負荷及溫度時序比較，並辨識以下失效情境：單一位置淨距正常仍可能在其他行程卡阻。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Long-term concrete deformation can affect gate clearance and travel. Distinguish material expansion from thermal and structural movement. A clearance deduction shows geometric consumption, while friction and skew also depend on supports and seals; inspect the entire travel path rather than one opening. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Survey clearance throughout the slot and compare operating loads and temperature histories. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Normal clearance at one position can coexist with binding elsewhere. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 備援隔水與載重~Backup isolation and loading
units.title: 備援隔水與載重~Backup isolation and loading
units.mechanism: 備援閘門或隔水構件的用途是建立可維護邊界，其受力取決於隔離後兩側水位，不能把平常低壓差當最不利情境。平均壓差乘面積只算給定分布的合力，導軌、密封與起吊狀態還需依完整工況驗證。 驗證時應將隔離前後水位組合列入荷載表並檢查導軌反力，並辨識以下失效情境：維修側排乾後壓差增加可能超出平常操作荷載。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Backup isolation establishes a maintainable boundary. Its load depends on both water levels after isolation, not the low differential during normal operation. Mean pressure times area gives one prescribed resultant; guides, seals and lifting states still need verification across the complete load cases. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: List pre- and post-isolation water levels and check guide reactions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Dewatering the maintenance side increases differential load beyond normal operation. units.anchor: 修復效益與同工況~Rehabilitation benefit and matched states
units.title: 修復效益與同工況~Rehabilitation benefit and matched states
units.mechanism: 修復驗證應使用相近水位、流量與閘門組合比較，否則較溫和的工況會被誤認成構造改善。無因次指標可降低部分尺度影響，但不消除地形與材料改變；應把壓力、沖蝕和操作可靠度分別建立證據鏈。 驗證時應用匹配工況資料比較壓力頻譜與空間分布而非只比較均值，並辨識以下失效情境：未匹配流量就計改善百分比可能製造虛假成效。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Evaluate rehabilitation at comparable levels, discharge and gate combinations. Milder operation can otherwise masquerade as structural improvement. Dimensionless measures reduce some scaling effects but do not remove geometry or material changes; maintain separate evidence for pressure, scour and operating reliability. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare spectra and spatial pressure distributions at matched conditions, not only means. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An improvement percentage without matched discharge can be misleading. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

sources.scope: 已讀2015年原始公告，核實1956至1959年建壩與修復融資；不以預定工期推論實際完工。
sources.scopeEn: Read the2015 announcement verifying construction in1956–1959 and rehabilitation financing; planned schedules are not treated as completion evidence.

sources.title: 卡里巴水墊整形業主說明
sources.scope: 已讀業主對沖坑、回向沖蝕、整形與圍堰施工的說明及1958年蓄水監測；舊文預定工期不當目前狀態。
sources.scopeEn: Read the owner account of scour, reshaping and cofferdam work, including monitoring since1958 impoundment; old schedule language is not a current-status assertion.

sources.title: 卡里巴溢洪閘門修復業主說明
sources.scope: 已讀六孔閘門、混凝土變形影響啟閉與備援隔水概念；頁內過時採購預計不作實際施工結論。
sources.scopeEn: Read the six-gate configuration, concrete-deformation operating concern and backup-isolation concept; outdated procurement forecasts are not treated as achieved work.

sources.title: 塔貝拉壩計畫原始績效評估
sources.titleEn: Original Tarbela Dam project performance audit
sources.scope: 已檢索1986年原始評估與工程附表，包含深厚地基鋪蓋、低位出口與卡里巴水墊比較；僅作歷史工程脈絡，不移植尺寸。
sources.scopeEn: Retrieved indexed sections of the1986 primary audit covering foundation blankets, low outlets and a Kariba pool comparison; used for historical context without transplanting dimensions.
